system.description:
At a door, window or other entrance, use an Interact Action and roll a Smarts Check to barricade it against pursuers. 1 success builds a barricade with CR 1 and 8 Health Points; each success beyond the first adds 2 Health Points.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.45
system.summary: At a door, window or other entrance, use an Interact Action and roll a Smarts Check to barricade it against pursuers. 1 success builds a barricade with CR 1 and 8 Health Points; each success beyond the first adds 2 Health Points.

automation.onSuccess: Barricade built: CR 1, 8 Health Points +2 per success beyond the first.

automation.note: Only at a door, window or other entrance. Barricade: CR 1, 8 HP +2 per extra success; the Director tracks it and how it slows pursuers.
